d:
Stop overthinking, negative thinking, and exam stress through this five-minute Yoga. Brahmari pranayama can also help you get deep sleep.
Bhramari Pranayam, the humming bee breath, is one of the oldest and most powerful yogic tools to stop overthinking and fall into deep, restorative sleep. In just 5 minutes, this gentle practice calms your nervous system, slows your racing thoughts, and signals to your body that it is safe to rest.
This video can be practiced anytime, anywhere. Simply keep a gap of 2 hours between a meal and practice.
